title: Hama's Standalone Dawnclient
description:
A mod pack designed for pvp.
 Formerly known as Hama's Standalone Featherclient
body:
Designed to bring pvp performance with minimal mod clutter. Highly reccomend to use with Prism Launcher https://prismlauncher.org/ 

What you can expect from this pack.
- 1.5 to 2x fps dependant on setup/gpu.
- Performance stack that actually works.
- A few of my perferred PvP resource packs.
- A lightweight easy to configure experience.
- Theobald's Practice World.

Huds: unknown compatibility due to dawnclient
- Less cluttered hud : biqtwrlq 
- Basic hud: siacmkwv

Contains:
- Nvidium Github beta (for older/newer versions) 
https://github.com/drouarb/nvidium/releases/tag/0.4.1-beta9
 (0.4.1-beta9 has majority of 1.21 versions).
- THEOBALD'S PVP PRACTICE 1.4 - 1.21.11 (https://shelledturtle.gumroad.com/l/TheosPVPPractice)
- Outside sourced packs from (https://packsmc.com/)

Working on releasing my personal pvp pack. In the meanwhile you could subscribe to me fr ;) (https://www.youtube.com/@Hamabost)
